request.query: Finitely supported natural coefficients: monotone linear combination as a function of generators in an ordered additive commutative monoid

items.informal_name: Sum Inequality for Finite Support Functions under Monotonicity
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : Preorder α] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid β]
  [inst_3 : PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [inst_5 : DecidableEq ι] {f₁ f₂ : ι →₀ α} {h : ι → α → β},
  f₁ ≤ f₂ →
    (∀ i ∈ f₁.support ∪ f₂.support, Monotone (h i)) → (∀ i ∈ f₁.support ∪ f₂.support, h i 0 = 0) → f₁.sum h ≤ f₂.sum h
items.informal_description: Let $\iota$ be an index type and $\alpha, \beta$ be types with $\alpha$ an ordered additive commutative monoid. For finite support functions $f_1, f_2 : \iota \to_0 \alpha$ satisfying $f_1 \le f_2$ pointwise, and a family of functions $h_i : \alpha \to \beta$ that are monotone on $\mathrm{supp}(f_1) \cup \mathrm{supp}(f_2)$ with $h_i(0) = 0$, the inequality $\sum h(f_1) \le \sum h(f_2)$ holds, where the sums are taken over the respective supports.

items.informal_name: Weight of Non-Zero Element is Less Than or Equal to Total Weight
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M]
  [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] (w : σ → M) {s : σ} {f : σ →₀ ℕ}, f s ≠ 0 → w s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f
items.informal_description: For any element $s$ in $\sigma$ and finite support function $f : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N}$, if $f(s) \neq 0$, then the weight $w(s)$ of $s$ is less than or equal to the total weight $\text{weight}_w(f)$ of $f$, where $\text{weight}_w(f) = \sum_{s \in \text{support}(f)} f(s) \cdot w(s)$.

items.informal_name: Lower bound on total weight from a non-zero component
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {w : σ → M},
  (∀ (s : σ), 0 ≤ w s) → ∀ {s : σ} {f : σ →₀ ℕ}, f s ≠ 0 → w s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f
items.informal_description: Let `σ` be an index set and `M` be an ordered additive commutative monoid. Let `w: σ → M` be a weight function with non-negative values, i.e., `w(s) ≥ 0` for all `s ∈ σ`. For any function `f : σ →₀ ℕ` with finite support, its total weight is defined as `weight w f = ∑_{s' ∈ σ} f(s') w(s')`. The theorem states that if `f(s) ≠ 0` for some index `s ∈ σ`, then `w(s)` provides a lower bound for the total weight, i.e., `w(s) ≤ weight w f`.

items.informal_name: Monotonicity of the Canonical Map from Finite Support Functions to Underlying Functions
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : Preorder M], Monotone Finsupp.toFun
items.informal_description: The canonical map from the set of finite support functions $\iota \to_0 M$ to the set of all functions $\iota \to M$ is monotone with respect to the pointwise preorder on both domains. Specifically, if $f \le g$ in $\iota \to_0 M$ under the pointwise preorder, then their underlying functions satisfy $f(i) \le g(i)$ for all $i \in \iota$.

items.informal_name: Monotonicity of Underlying Function Map for Finite Support Functions
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : Preorder M], Monotone Finsupp.toFun
items.informal_description: The canonical map from finite support functions $\iota \to_0 M$ to their underlying functions $\iota \to M$ is monotone with respect to the pointwise preorder. Specifically, if $f \le g$ in the pointwise preorder on $\iota \to_0 M$, then their underlying functions satisfy $f \le g$ in the component-wise preorder on $\iota \to M$.

items.informal_name: Sum of Finite Support Functions Preserves Inequality
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] {f : ι →₀ α} {h₁ h₂ : ι → α → β},
  (∀ i ∈ f.support, h₁ i (f i) ≤ h₂ i (f i)) → f.sum h₁ ≤ f.sum h₂
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \alpha \to₀ M $ in an ordered additive commutative monoid $ M $, if $ h₁(i, f(i)) \leq h₂(i, f(i)) $ for all $ i $ in the support of $ f $, then the sum of $ h₁ $ over $ f $ satisfies $ \sum_{i \in \text{supp}(f)} h₁(i, f(i)) \leq \sum_{i \in \text{supp}(f)} h₂(i, f(i)) $.

items.informal_name: Monotonicity of Domain Mapping for Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α]
  {f : ι → κ}, Monotone (Finsupp.mapDomain f)
items.informal_description: The function $\text{mapDomain } f$ is monotone with respect to the pointwise preorder on finite support functions. That is, for any function $f : \alpha \to \beta$ and finite support functions $v, w : \alpha \to_0 \alpha$, if $v \leq w$ pointwise, then $\text{mapDomain } f \, v \leq \text{mapDomain } f \, w$ pointwise.

items.informal_name: Finite Support Functions Form Canonically Ordered Additive Monoid Under Left Monotonic Addition
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd α]
  [inst_3 : Sub α] [OrderedSub α] [AddLeftMono α], CanonicallyOrderedAdd (ι →₀ α)
items.informal_description: If $ \alpha $ is an additive monoid with left monotonic addition (i.e., for all $ m, n_1, n_2 \in \alpha $, $ n_1 \leq n_2 $ implies $ m + n_1 \leq m + n_2 $), then the type of finite support functions $ \iota \to₀ \alpha $ forms a canonically ordered additive monoid. This means the pointwise order on finite support functions satisfies the canonical order property: for any $ f, g $, $ f \leq g $ if and only if there exists a function $ h $ such that $ g = f + h $ pointwise.

items.informal_name: Left addition monotonicity for colexicographic ordered finite support functions
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : AddMonoid N] [inst_2 : LinearOrder N]
  [AddLeftStrictMono N], AddLeftMono (Colex (α →₀ N))
items.informal_description: For the colexicographic partial order on finite support functions $\alpha \to_0 N$, left addition preserves the order: for any functions $f, g, h \in \mathrm{Colex}(\alpha \to_0 N)$, if $g \leq h$ then $f + g \leq f + h$.

items.informal_name: Right Addition is Monotonic in Colexicographic Order on Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : AddMonoid N] [inst_2 : LinearOrder N]
  [AddRightStrictMono N], AddRightMono (Colex (α →₀ N))
items.informal_description: In the colexicographic order on finite support functions from $\alpha$ to $N$, right addition preserves the order. Specifically, for any functions $f, g, h : \alpha \to_0 N$, if $f \leq g$ then $f + h \leq g + h$, where the order is defined by comparing the rightmost differing coordinate under a linear order on $\alpha$.
